# Source-bound unchanged native width evidence

An unchanged-native-width contract is supported only for the exact independently approved source-bound operation. Keep the original PNG gate FAIL and raw measurements. The exception substitutes exact native width identity only where both local width estimates are null; a one-null or finite estimate is not eligible. Geometry, style, resource custody, nonempty isolated status pixels, and isolated RGB equality at all prescribed scales must be proven by the pinned primitive.

Do not omit present statuses, expand masks, change thresholds, or suppress other color, softness, centerline, texture, or unexpected-status checks. Independent review must inspect the seven prescribed fresh RGB PNGs; every decoded image must match fresh pixels and exact source, plan, operation and receipt bindings. Both release gates consume the same approved immutable contract. A reviewer name alone is not approval.

Saved delivery is a separate reviewed branch. The immutable working operation remains subject to exact replay custody; an accepted strict delivery primitive may subsequently verify only the observed delivery wrapper. A saved receipt never replaces the working contract or authorizes arbitrary object changes.

## Exact saved delivery

Use `saved_native_unchanged_width_review` only with the independently approved bound saved contract; it is mutually exclusive with the direct working contract field. Preserve the immutable approved working operation, contract, final review, complete gates and activation. Replay them before strict delivery custody and seven separately captured actual saved PNGs. The saved approval pins every actual identity and the genuine independent visual receipt. Both current saved-file gates remain mandatory.
